name: Tank Warfare
author: Sixth Front
description: A battle type: pick TANKS on the main menu. Everyone commands a tank, you and every bot, on Iron Steppe, a wide open map of farms, a rail depot and the crossroads town of Karsk. The class cards are your four crew slots from the RESEARCH screen: you drive your own tank as the one you picked (M60A3 to M1A2 SEPv3, T-62M to T-90M), with its armour, speed, reload and gun and the modifications you fitted. A destroyed tank comes back at the HQ a few seconds later.

battle.name: TANKS
battle.tagline: Iron Steppe. Every soldier commands a tank (or an attack helicopter flying ground support): ten a side across farms, a rail depot and the crossroads town of Karsk. Take the flags and keep your armour alive.

crew1.name: CREW 1
crew1.blurb: The tank in your first crew slot. Change your crew in the RESEARCH screen.

crew2.name: CREW 2
crew2.blurb: The tank in your second crew slot.

crew3.name: CREW 3
crew3.blurb: The tank in your third crew slot.

crew4.name: CREW 4
crew4.blurb: The tank in your fourth crew slot.

script: // A battle mod turns the match into a vehicle battle: every soldier (you and the bots) deploys straight into
// a vehicle, and the deploy screen only offers places where vehicles can join the fight.
const g = api.game, pc = g.playerCtl, hud = g.hud, ui = g.ui, world = g.world;
const { HQS, TEAMS, RULES, VEHICLES } = api.config;
const clamp = (v, a, b) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v);
const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
const h = api.addModel([{ shape: 'box', size: [0.01, 0.01, 0.01] }], { x: 0, y: -500, z: 0 });
// Replaces a method and remembers how to put the old one back
undo.push(() => { if (obj[name] === fn) { if (own) obj[name] = prev; else delete obj[name]; } });
onOff(() => { for (const u of undo.splice(0).reverse()) { try { u(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } });
const MAPSIZE = api.mapSize ? api.mapSize() : { play: 240, world: 560 };
const surface = (x, z) => { const h = world.heightAt(x, z); return SEA !== null && SEA > h ? SEA : h; };
// how many vehicles each side gets: one per soldier, up to a cap
// (the same on every page, so online games agree on the list of vehicles)
// The place a bot rejoins the fight: usually the held flag closest to the enemy, otherwise its HQ
for (const f of g.mode.flags) if (f.owner !== team) d = Math.min(d, Math.hypot(f.x - p.x, f.z - p.z));
if (d < bd) { bd = d; pt = p; }
// B: { noun, plural, free(team) -> vehicles ready to take, keep(point) -> deploy points shown,
//      board(soldier, vehicle, point) -> put the soldier in the vehicle at that point, pickFor(point) -> the player's vehicle }
// People (you, and other players in an online game) on a side who are waiting to deploy
const humansWaiting = (team) => (g.state === 'menu' ? 0 : g.soldiers.filter((s) => (s.isPlayer || (s.mp && s.mp.player)) && s.team === team && s.state !== 'alive' && s.state !== 'downed').length);
// the bots leave a vehicle for each person on their side who is choosing where to deploy
if (forPlayer && B.label) for (const p of pts) B.label(p, team);
// bots respawn straight into a free vehicle, or wait for one
// the Multiplayer mod asks which vehicle you'd get (to claim it from the host first), then deploys with it
const pick = (point, skip) => (B.pickFor ? B.pickFor(point, skip) : readyFor(g.player.team, false, skip)[0]) || null;
if (P.state === 'alive' && P.vehicle !== v) B.board(P, v, point);
// the deploy button waits while no vehicle is ready
// Every soldier commands a tank. Each side gets one tank per soldier (up to 10); a destroyed tank comes back
// at its HQ after a few seconds, and that's the next tank someone deploys in, at the HQ or at a held flag.
// The deploy screen's four class cards are your crew slots (the Career's research screen): pick one and you
// drive your own tank (one a side, never taken by the bots) as that tank, with its strengths and modifications
const tankCrew = (slot) => { const C = g.__career; return C && C.deployable ? C.deployable('tank', slot) : slot === 0 ? { id: 'starter', fx: {} } : null; };
const playerSlot = () => { const m = /^crew([1-4])$/.exec(g.ui.selectedClass || ''); return m ? +m[1] - 1 : 0; };
const ownTank = (team) => tanks().find((v) => v.team === team && v.reserved) || null;
const tankName = (it) => { const C = g.__career; return it && it.tree && C && C.itemName ? C.itemName(it) : VEHICLES.tank.name; };
// parking rows behind each HQ, facing the enemy
const fx = -Math.sin(hq.yaw), fz = -Math.cos(hq.yaw), rx = Math.cos(hq.yaw), rz = -Math.sin(hq.yaw);
return { x: hq.x + rx * col * 10 - fx * (14 + row * 13), z: hq.z + rz * col * 10 - fz * (14 + row * 13), yaw: hq.yaw };
v.yaw = yaw; v.turretYaw = yaw; v.gunPitch = 0; v.speed = 0;
if (Math.abs(world.heightAt(x + 3, z) - y) > 1.6 || Math.abs(world.heightAt(x, z + 3) - y) > 1.6) return false;
if (SEA !== null && y < SEA + 0.5) return false;
for (const o of g.vehicles) if (o !== v && o.exists && Math.hypot(o.pos.x - x, o.pos.z - z) < 9) return false;
const oy = v.pos.y, ox = v.pos.x, oz = v.pos.z;
// Moves a waiting tank to where someone deploys: its parking spot at the HQ, or beside a held flag
const hq = HQS[v.team], enemy = HQS[1 - v.team];
if (clearAt(v, p.x, p.z) || Math.hypot(v.pos.x - p.x, v.pos.z - p.z) > 1) setPose(v, p.x, p.z, p.yaw);
const face = yawTo(enemy.x - f.x, enemy.z - f.z);
const back = Math.atan2(hq.x - f.x, hq.z - f.z); // direction from the flag toward our HQ
const a = back + rand(-1.3, 1.3) * (0.5 + i / 40), r = f.radius + rand(6, 26) + i * 0.6;
const x = f.x + Math.sin(a) * r, z = f.z + Math.cos(a) * r;
if (clearAt(v, x, z)) { setPose(v, x, z, face); return; }
// a bot that just took off in a helicopter (the Helicopters mod boards some as they respawn) stays in it
if (s.vehicle && s.vehicle.isAircraft && s.vehicle.driver === s && s.vehicle.alive) return;
if (s.vehicle && s.vehicle.isAircraft && s.vehicle.driver === s && s.vehicle.alive) return;
if (s.brain) { s.brain.wantTank = null; s.brain.target = null; s.brain.tankTarget = null; }
if (s === g.player) { pc.camYaw = v.turretYaw; pc.camPitch = -0.08; pc.tankWeapon = 0; }
// one tank per soldier: the engine's four plus as many more as the match needs
let have = g.vehicles.filter((v) => v instanceof TankClass && v.team === team && !v.reserved);
for (let slot = have.length; slot < want; slot++) {
const t = new TankClass(g, team, 10 + slot);
have = g.vehicles.filter((v) => v instanceof TankClass && v.team === team && !v.reserved);
have.forEach((t, i) => { t.isBattleTank = i < want; if (!t.isBattleTank) { t.exists = false; t.alive = false; t.hull.visible = false; } });
// and your own (the same list on every page, so online games agree)
if (!g.vehicles.some((v) => v instanceof TankClass && v.team === team && v.reserved)) {
const t = new TankClass(g, team, 40 + team);
// a respawned tank waits in the HQ's parking rows
t.spawn = function () { TankClass.prototype.spawn.call(this); const p = parkSpot(this); setPose(this, p.x, p.z, p.yaw); };
for (const t of g.vehicles) { if (t.isBattleTank) delete t.isBattleTank; if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(t, 'spawn')) delete t.spawn; }
// your own attack helicopter (the Helicopters mod, built in) can join a tank battle too, for ground support
const heliOk = (a) => !!a && a.kind === 'heli' && a.state === 'ready' && !a.exists && (!g.__career || !g.__career.deployable || !!g.__career.deployable('air', a.type.id, a.team));
const selAir = () => { const pt = g.ui.selectedPoint && g.ui.selectedPoint(); return pt && pt.type === 'air' ? pt : null; };
free: (team) => tanks().filter((v) => v.team === team && v.alive && v.exists && !v.driver && !v.reserved),
if (s.state !== 'alive') { const hq = HQS[s.team]; s.spawn(hq.x, world.heightAt(hq.x, hq.z) + 0.1, hq.z, hq.yaw); }
if (pt && pt.type === 'air') return heliOk(pt.air) && !(skip && skip.has(pt.air)) ? pt.air : null;
if (own && own.alive && own.exists && !own.driver && !(skip && skip.has(own))) return own;
// online, a friend on your side may have it out: then one from the pool

if (g.__mp && g.__mp.live() && own && own.driver && own.driver !== P) return tanks().find((v) => v.team === P.team && v.alive && v.exists && !v.driver && !v.reserved && !(skip && skip.has(v))) || null;
if (!heliOk(a) && a.state === 'ready' && !a.exists) return `${a.type.short} IS NOT IN YOUR CREW SLOTS · RESEARCH SCREEN`;
if (!heliOk(a)) return `YOUR ${a.type.short} · BACK IN ${Math.ceil(Math.max(0, a.respawnT || 0))} S`;
if (!tankCrew(playerSlot())) return 'EMPTY CREW SLOT · RESEARCH SCREEN';
if (own && !own.alive) return `YOUR TANK · BACK IN ${Math.ceil(Math.max(0, own.respawnT || 0))} S`;
if (own && own.driver && own.driver !== P) return 'YOUR TANK IS OUT';
p.label = own && !own.alive ? `HEADQUARTERS · YOUR TANK BACK IN ${Math.ceil(Math.max(0, own.respawnT || 0))} S` : 'HEADQUARTERS · YOUR TANK READY';
// your tank as the one in the crew slot you picked: its armour, speed, turret, reload and gun
const b = (it && it.tree && C && C.bonus ? C.bonus('tank', it) : null) || {};
if (it && it.tree && C && C.used) C.used('tank', it.id);
if (!b || !this.driver || this.driver !== g.player) return prev.call(this, dt);
const T = VEHICLES.tank, keep = { speed: T.speed, reverse: T.reverse, turnRate: T.turnRate, turretSpeed: T.turretSpeed, reload: T.reload };
T.speed *= b.speed || 1; T.reverse *= b.speed || 1; T.turnRate *= b.turn || 1; T.turretSpeed *= b.turret || 1; T.reload *= b.reload || 1;
try { return prev.call(this, dt); } finally { Object.assign(T, keep); }
const v = attacker && attacker === g.player && attacker.vehicle;
api.filter('vehicleDamage', (e) => { e.amount *= gunMul(e.attacker, e.weapon); return e; });
api.filter('damage', (e) => { e.amount *= gunMul(e.attacker, e.info && e.info.weapon); return e; });
// your own tank is back at the HQ ten seconds after it's knocked out
api.on('vehicleDestroyed', (e) => { if (e.vehicle && e.vehicle.reserved && e.vehicle.isBattleTank) e.vehicle.respawnT = Math.min(e.vehicle.respawnT || 10, 10); });
api.on('exitVehicle', (e) => { if (e.soldier === g.player && e.vehicle.isBattleTank) { const vt = $('vh-title'); if (vt) vt.textContent = VEHICLES.tank.name; } });
// the crew slot cards on the deploy screen
const txt = it ? tankName(it) : 'EMPTY CREW SLOT';
const sub = !it ? 'PUT A TANK HERE IN THE RESEARCH SCREEN' : own && !own.alive ? `YOUR TANK · BACK IN ${Math.ceil(Math.max(0, own.respawnT || 0))} S` : 'YOUR TANK · READY';
if (ii && ii.textContent !== sub) { ii.textContent = sub; ii.style.color = it ? '' : '#ff7a6a'; }
try { ui.renderClassCards(); } catch (e) { /* no deploy screen yet */ }
onOff(() => { try { ui.renderClassCards(); } catch (e) { /* menu gone */ } });
// Bots in tanks: armour covers ground fast, so a flag that is already safely held is left to someone else
// and the tanks push on to the next one (a few stay back as defenders)
const s = this.s, v = s.vehicle, flags = g.mode.flags;
if (!this.tankPref || this.tankPref.length !== flags.length) { this.tankPref = flags.map(() => rand(0, 45)); this.defender = Math.random() < 0.2; }
const d = Math.hypot(f.x - v.pos.x, f.z - v.pos.z);
if (sc > bs) { bs = sc; best = f; }
if (best && best !== this.objective) { this.objective = best; this.moveTarget = null; }
// The tank's sight reaches across the bigger map
const s = this.s, v = s && s.vehicle;
const h = world.raycast(cam.position.x, cam.position.y, cam.position.z, dir.x, dir.y, dir.z, 900, true);
const ox = v.pos.x, oy = v.pos.y + 1.9, oz = v.pos.z;
v.input.aimPitch = Math.atan2(h.y - oy, Math.hypot(h.x - ox, h.z - oz));
// Leaving your tank in a tank battle: you're a crewman on foot with your class kit until you find another
if (e.soldier === g.player && e.vehicle.isBattleTank) api.toast('ON FOOT · FIND A TANK OR REDEPLOY');
